article_limitations: Cohort median age is printed as 30 (24-51) in the abstract and text but as 30 (28-51) in the Table 1 median row; no individual value is changed. The median row is cohort-level and is not a patient fact.

Cohort median 3-month monthly headache days is printed as 2 (2-8) in the abstract and Treatment efficacy text but as 5 (2-8) in the Table 1 median row. Both are cohort-level statistics, not patient facts, and are not reconciled.
The text calls the Table 1 Onset age column median the past years from the first repetitive headache; the onset values are recorded as review_only without a unit.
The abstract describes eight patients treated by telemedicine for three months, but patients 5 and 6 have no three-month values and were referred at the one-month follow-up visit.
Source typos kept as printed in evidence: Propranorol, MDH, MMD and OCT analgesics.
Table 1 uses a dash for empty Comorbidities and Medication cells without defining it; dashes are not recorded as negatives. Individual patient ages in Table 1 have no stated reference time.
Figure 1 caption visual status not_inspected in this annotation; the image was inspected in the separate visual.json.
Discussion statements about telemedicine and published studies are not patient facts.
Cohort median 0-month HIT-6 is printed as 63 (58-64) in the abstract and Treatment efficacy text but as 63 (57-64) in the Table 1 median row; cohort-level only, not reconciled.

Cohort-level statements without explicit coverage of every patient are not copied to individuals: no major adverse effects of the prophylactic medications, the planned medication adjustment, face-to-face consultations and referral to local doctors, and the methods description of re-examination on the seventh day.

The 0-month column is identified with before treatment by the methods outcome definition and the Figure 1 caption; that wording orders each patient's 0-month values before the prophylactic prescription. The prescription is not ordered against the 1-month values because Table 1 does not state when each listed drug was started.
